instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Tell Trillion my AI did the next step of a decision, or the exact wall it reached", and give it decision_id; state; what_happened.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:say-what-was-done and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Keeps, with the decision generation it carried out, that its next action was done (state done) or the exact wall reached (state wall: the file, field, refused command or missing credential), in what_happened.

4. It reads only the records handed in as `records` (decision; decision-revision; decision-step; decision-call; decision-evidence; decision-answered-step; decision-option; decision-candidate; decision-report; decision-carried-out; decision-history; decision-cited-pursuit; decision-method; decision-part; decision-refs; calendar-task; pursuit; record:check; record:decision-kind). The changes come back as keep, each with the value it expected, for the caller to write to its own store.
